howItWorks.title: How Table Ordering Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Designed around real dining ergonomics: no app downloads, no account walls, and no handing your phone or card around the table.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Your physical table stand connects you straight to your table's live menu with full modifier customization and dietary filtering.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Friends at your table join with the 4-digit table PIN to add their own dishes. The Table Host reviews and fires the unified order to the kitchen.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Track cooking stages live from the pass. When ready, split by diner, equally, or by item—everyone pays their share on their own device.

dish-burger-01.name: Angus Flame-Grilled Burger
dish-burger-01.description: Prime Angus beef patty seared over open white-oak coals, melted aged farmhouse cheddar, house smoked relish, and warm brioche.

dish-burger-02.name: Nashville Hot Crispy Chicken Sandwich
dish-burger-02.description: Double-dredged buttermilk fried chicken breast dunked in habanero-cayenne hot honey, bread-and-butter pickles, and cool herb slaw on toasted potato roll.

dish-burger-03.name: Smoky BBQ Bacon Flame Burger
dish-burger-03.description: Flame-charred beef patty, applewood smoked bacon rashers, smoky bourbon barbecue reduction, crispy onion haystack.

dish-burger-04.name: Angus Reserve Smash Burger
dish-burger-04.description: Double 100% Black Angus smashed patties with crisp lace edges, aged American cheddar, house smoked relish, and caramelized sweet onions.

dish-steak-01.name: 45-Day Dry Aged Ribeye (350g)
dish-steak-01.description: Prime cut ribeye with heavy intramuscular marbling, seared over white oak coals, basted in brown butter, roasted garlic, and garden thyme.

dish-steak-02.name: Prime Filet Mignon (250g)
dish-steak-02.description: Center-cut Black Angus tenderloin, exceptionally tender, served with rosemary roasted marrow bone and Maldon sea salt flakes.

dish-steak-03.name: Black Angus Striploin (300g)
dish-steak-03.description: Grain-fed Kansas cut strip loin with a crisp fat cap, wood-fired at 800 degrees with cracked black pepper and herb butter.

dish-pizza-01.name: San Marzano Margherita D.O.P.
dish-pizza-01.description: Campania whole peeled tomatoes, fresh fior di latte mozzarella, cold-pressed olive oil, and sweet genovese basil on leopard-spotted sourdough crust.

dish-pizza-02.name: Spicy Pepperoni & Hot Honey
dish-pizza-02.description: Crisped pepperoni cups, crushed red pepper flakes, whole milk mozzarella, and habanero chili wildflower honey drizzle.

dish-pizza-03.name: Truffle Mushroom & Taleggio
dish-pizza-03.description: White base with roasted cremini, shiitake and oyster mushrooms, creamy taleggio cheese, fresh thyme, and black truffle drizzle.

dish-pasta-01.name: Braised Short Rib Rigatoni
dish-pasta-01.description: Fresh bronze-cut rigatoni tossed with 12-hour braised beef short rib sugo, San Marzano tomatoes, and aged Pecorino Romano.

dish-pasta-02.name: Truffle Parmesan Hand-Cut Fries
dish-pasta-02.description: Russet potatoes fried twice in pure beef tallow, tossed with white truffle oil, sea salt flakes, fresh parsley, and grated Parmigiano.

dish-drink-01.name: Smoked Vanilla Bean Espresso Gelato
dish-drink-01.description: House-spun Madagascar vanilla bean gelato drenched in hot double ristretto espresso, topped with dark chocolate sea salt shavings.

dish-drink-02.name: Blood Orange & Rosemary Soda
dish-drink-02.description: Cold-pressed Sicilian blood orange juice, sparkling mineral water, charred rosemary sprig, and raw cane sugar reduction.
